dedupe_keys.name: global solar pv inventory preparation pipeline

description: This repository publishes the machine-learning and remote-sensing pipeline used by Kruitwagen and co-authors to map commercial, industrial and utility photovoltaic facilities. It documents Sentinel-2 and SPOT training, cloud deployment, polygon filtering, capacity estimation and matching to existing power-plant inventories. The reported application identified 68,661 facilities above 10 kilowatts using imagery through the end of 2018, with geographic search restricted by population-based coverage. Public Python code and workflow instructions are free under MIT. A limitation is that full reproduction requires Descartes Labs alpha access, licensed Airbus SPOT imagery and, for the documented matching configuration, Gurobi. These external requirements are separate from the code licence; data terms are not inferred from MIT. The pipeline can prepare asset locations and capacity estimates for infrastructure simulations and comparisons with model-pypsa inputs. The 2021 Nature article and a separate Zenodo dataset are linked. This record concerns the reusable processing software. No imagery, trained model or dataset was downloaded, and historical cloud compatibility remains untested.
name: Global solar-PV inventory preparation pipeline
notes: G7 G7-0516. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-27; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
